name: user-management
description: Members surface (P1): searchable/sortable member table with inline role dropdown, soft-remove, permission-gated invite. Props-driven + RBAC-agnostic; pair with rbac-roles + convex-auth.
notes: 0.1.0 (2026-05-31): P1 of the user-management epic. Members table only. RBAC-agnostic by design — the slice imports no other slice's frontend; roles + resolved permissions are passed as props (wire from rbac-roles at the app level). Convex side reuses rbac-roles' requirePermission/getActorPermissions. Invites (P2) + roles admin (P3) + full-parity extras (P4) follow.
